comment: Survey-product registry: one entry per monitored DTV channel. Resolution order per channel: explicit 'path' (products.local.json first, then here), else each search dir is tried for {freq_id}.npz then *-{freq_id}.npz. Dirs from $BAONOISE_PRODUCT_DIRS (colon-separated) are searched first; relative dirs resolve against the repo root. Machine-local additions belong in data/products.local.json (gitignored), never here.
